summary.intent: Improve Cohezion's ability to model agents as Exotic Vacuum Objects (EVOs) by wiring QuadratureNexus deliberations through FLUME VAE encoding into SurrealDB, using Ouroboros for failure detection and Mycelium for skill synthesis, and feeding synthesized patterns back to improve consensus scores (closed loop). Run the system overnight and scale it continuously.
summary.outcome: Completed E1–E63 experiments validating the full EVO closed-loop pipeline. Discovered and fixed a critical bug where `apply_mycelium_feedback` used SET semantics (causing cycle-2 decay); the additive fix (`_mycelium_calibration +=`) enables monotonic consensus compounding toward 0.85. Derived and validated the convergence formula `consensus_n = 0.85 − 0.125 × (1−lr/2)^n`. Committed production fix with 11 regression tests and opened PR #113.

repo: The SCHEDULE experiment labels (e.g. 'E63_mycelium') must exactly match the experiment= strings passed to log_result (e.g. 'E63') for the retirement criterion to work — a label mismatch silently breaks auto-pruning.
The autoresearch loop is on branch `autoresearch/pr-merge-20260502`; a separate interactive rebase (104 commits) ran concurrently from another process, causing detached HEAD state.
Pre-commit playwright hook runs unconditionally with no `files:` filter, blocking all commits that touch non-UI files when Next.js server is not running.
The Gemini worktree at `.gemini/worktrees/2026-05-02-03-57-33-561-fvqr/` was silently cleaned up, losing ~1500 lines of E55-E62 experiment code — never rely on worktrees for durable storage.

SurrealQL probe must use `RETURN true;` not `SELECT 1;`. Datetime fields require `time::now()`, not ISO string literals. SCHEMAFULL tables block arbitrary metadata subfields — use `option<string>` with JSON-encoded payloads instead.

Lemonade local inference (port 13307) enters a silent failure mode where all evaluation prompts return empty strings but arithmetic still works — use a functional probe (`2+2=`) rather than `/models` endpoint to detect this.
The `pyproject.toml` had unresolved merge conflicts between HEAD and `isolated/session-oom-modularity` blocking `uv run` for the entire session.
ruff's pre-commit hook reformats files between Edit calls, requiring re-staging before commit. The overnight loop scripts are excluded from ruff E501 via `per-file-ignores` in pyproject.toml.
Vault observations are stored at `~/vaults/cohezion-vault/memory/observations.jsonl` and can be written directly. Vault IDs 39-46 hold E55-E63 findings.

The quad-silver proposal formula (architecture + safety/align + efficient/optimize + budget=True) produces 100% heuristic approval. Resource voice baseline is 0.65; budget=True adds +0.15, description cost/budget/efficient keywords add +0.10.
E51 ran 4,786 times with no stop condition before a retirement criterion was implemented — the CV < 0.05 after 20 keeps rule is the correct guard.

code.finding: run_llm_deliberation() unconditionally SETs _score_adjustments[vt] = (llm_score - base) + mycelium_calib on every call, wiping any Mycelium adjustments before the next deliberation sees them. E55-E62 must call nexus.deliberate() directly to preserve calibration.

apply_mycelium_feedback() had SET semantics (_score_adjustments[vt] = adjustment) causing cycle-2 decay. E57 fix: accumulate into _mycelium_calibration[vt] += adjustment, then _score_adjustments[vt] = _mycelium_calibration[vt]. _mycelium_calibration must be initialized in __init__ as dict.fromkeys(VoiceType, 0.0).

_evaluate_resource() now checks description keywords ('cost','budget','efficient','resource','reduce') for +0.10 bonus, making it text-sensitive like the other voices. Voice→Manifold mapping: Architect→dims 0-2, Engineer→dims 4,5,8, Ethicist→dim 9, Resource→dim 11.

Was entirely simulated — connect() set self.connected=True with no real HTTP call. Full rewrite using httpx with POST to http://127.0.0.1:8001/sql. Headers: Authorization: Basic root:root, surreal-ns: cohezion, surreal-db: main. Probe with RETURN true; not SELECT 1. All datetime fields use time::now(). EVO biography stored in result field (option<string>) to bypass SCHEMAFULL metadata restrictions.

Added ingest_evo_journeys(event_metadata_list) and _synthesize_evo_deliberation_skill(). Synthesized skill content uses format 'architect: mean_score=X.XXXX' — tests must match this format, not the voice_scores=[...] ingest input format.

E11 bug: called surprise_score(state, action, action) — passed action as both action AND observed_next, with train_epoch never called. Correct usage: collect (s_t, voice_action_t, s_{t+1}) triplets, call train_epoch, then measure initial_loss vs final_loss decrease.
TelemetryBus events never reached SurrealDB because bus.start() and worker.start() were never called at startup. Overnight loop must await both in main() to activate the worker loop.

New file: 11 regression tests guarding the E57 additive calibration fix. Tests verify: _mycelium_calibration in __init__, mechanism='additive_calibration', cycle-2 does not decay (E56 regression guard), 5-cycle monotonic compounding, lr=2.0 crosses 0.85 threshold, full pipeline lifts deliberation.

Tight spin-loop bug: asyncio.wait_for(coro, timeout=min(3600, remaining_s - 10)) passes negative float when remaining_s < 10, causing immediate TimeoutError on every iteration. Fix: max(1.0, remaining_s - 10) with early exit check.

E47 experiments must modify _mycelium_calibration (stable cross-cycle), NOT _score_adjustments (overwritten per-deliberation by run_llm_deliberation). Two-layer model: _mycelium_calibration for persistent gains, _score_adjustments as read surface for _evaluate_* methods.

workflow: timeit.default_timer() (alias for time.perf_counter()) is the correct instrument for experiment wall-clock measurement — unaffected by NTP corrections unlike time.time().

Retirement criterion design: retire if (a) n_keeps >= 20 AND CV of last 10 keep metrics < 0.05 (converged attractor), OR (b) 0% keep rate with n_runs >= min_runs (confirmed noise). Prevents running E12/E46/E47 indefinitely once they've saturated.

IEEE 754 edge case at consensus=0.85: sum([0.85]*n)/n evaluates to <0.85 due to float precision. Use result.approved (direct comparison to the class constant) as the authoritative threshold-crossing test, not mean comparison.

Pre-specifying falsification criteria before running experiments prevents metric redesigns mid-stream (E50 needed 3 redesigns, E54 needed 2). The V-model check: does the metric actually measure the claim?

Convergence formula for Mycelium compounding: consensus_n = threshold − gap_0 × (1 − lr/2)^n. At lr=1.0, converges asymptotically to threshold. At lr=2.0, crosses threshold exactly in one cycle. Validated to max_error=0.00025.

When 73% of SurrealDB records are inflated (from accumulation bug), split analysis into honest/inflated buckets before drawing conclusions. The honest LLM baseline was 0.768 vs the inflated apparent baseline of 0.838.
Multiple overnight loop processes accumulate silently — always kill all instances before restart with pkill -f, not just the most recent PID.

Properly sandboxed gymnasium experiments (ManifoldEnv/SwarmEnv) provide physics-grounded metrics (reward, HIHO time fraction, convergence steps) that are more meaningful than heuristic consensus proxies.

Each experiment should produce a single numeric metric for the retirement criterion. Experiments returning complex result dicts (like E12 returning biography) must have an explicit keep_fn that extracts the primary metric.

autorun_2h.py tight spin-loop at session deadline: negative timeout to asyncio.wait_for caused immediate TimeoutError on every slot, flooding monitor output and requiring manual process kill.
Multiple autorun_2h and overnight_evo_loop processes accumulated silently across restarts, running duplicate experiments and causing log file confusion.
SCHEDULE experiment labels (e.g. 'E55_mycelium') did not match the experiment= strings in log_result (e.g. 'E55'), silently breaking the retirement criterion for an entire session.
Monitor filters matched too broadly, triggering notifications for every deliberation cycle rather than just experiment completions — required iterative tightening of grep patterns.
pre-commit was missing from the venv and needed reinstallation mid-session, adding unexpected friction to the commit workflow.
open_items: apply_mycelium_feedback() has no callers in src/ beyond tests — the production closed loop is still not wired into CompoundExecutor or any orchestration layer.

Ouroboros fires 320+ HIHO drift warnings on experimental EVO lifecycle transitions (EVO reset between experiment phases = apparent coherence drop). Needs a guard to distinguish production events from experimental artifacts.

Mycelium synthesized skills are local instances per experiment run — they don't persist into the production MyceliumRegistry across sessions. A shared persistent registry was designed but lost with the Gemini worktree.
SurrealDB experiment_runs table has 0 records — the HTTP-direct write code was in the lost Gemini worktree and needs to be re-implemented in the main repo scripts.
E55-E62 experiments call nexus.deliberate() directly, bypassing the telemetry bus entirely. These 41,983 JSONL records are not in SurrealDB journey_point. Needs deliberation-level SurrealDB wiring.

JEPA world model (E46) shows flat initial_loss ~0.97-1.00 across all runs — heuristic mode produces a single-attractor distribution that JEPA cannot generalize from. Needs LLM mode with real score variance.
E64 (multi-cycle compounding with additive semantics) was added to the overnight loop schedule but not yet validated — first empirical result pending.
Retirement criterion uses in-memory state per process — experiments don't auto-retire on restart. Seeding _retirement_keeps from autoresearch.jsonl on startup would give cross-session persistence.
PR #113 (autoresearch/pr-merge-20260502 → main) is open but the retirement criterion commit may not have pushed cleanly due to rebase conflicts near the end of session.
Lemonade iGPU ROCm silent failure recovery is pending — the autorun_2h LLM functional probe (2+2= test) will auto-detect when it recovers, but the root cause (ROCm stack state) is unaddressed.
autorun_2h.py negative-timeout spin-loop fix was implemented but its commit status is uncertain after the concurrent rebase disrupted the working tree.
SurrealDB query_evo_trajectory uses string::starts_with which is not supported in the installed SurrealDB version — needs alternative query approach or version upgrade.
